---
title: "Scaling Machine Learning Systems"
subtitle: "Semester plan · Volume II"
---

## Overview {#overview}

Students study how distributed training, communication, fault recovery, and
serving work across many machines, and they defend a system design in a final
project. The course assumes the introductory course or equivalent background.

## Syllabus and schedule {#syllabus}

The [semester syllabus](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/scale-syllabus.html)
lists one Volume II chapter for each of the 16 weeks. Each offering sets its own
dates and course policies.

## Materials {#materials}

| Resource | Use |
|:---|:---|
| [Volume II](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol2/) | The weekly readings. |
| [Lecture slides](https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol2.html) | One deck per chapter, with speaker notes and in-class exercises. |
| [Interactive labs](https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/) | Browser-based systems experiments that pair with the readings. |

## For instructors {#for-instructors}

The course can also serve as the second half of a two-semester sequence that
begins with the [introductory course](../intro/index.qmd).

## Offerings {#offerings}

The [course directory](../index.qmd) lists courses at other institutions that use
MLSysBook.
